about_short_description.short_description: Preserving trust in digital media by fighting AI-based misinformation and deepfakes

product.name: Clarity Hiring Security Platform
product.description: An end-to-end security overlay for hiring and onboarding that detects candidate fraud, synthetic media, AI-assisted cheating, and identity mismatches across the talent lifecycle.

product.name: AI Deepfake Detection
product.description: A real-time and recorded-media analysis service that detects manipulated video and audio, including face swaps, AI masks, voice clones, and lip-sync inconsistencies.

product.name: Application Verification
product.description: An AI-assisted application screening service that analyzes candidate profiles, resumes, behavioral signals, identity data, and media patterns for signs of fabricated or manipulated applicants.

product.name: Identity Confirmation
product.description: A real-time identity verification service that confirms a candidate’s identity during hiring and before access is granted to sensitive systems or data.

product.name: Uncovering Proxy Identities
product.description: A continuous biometric verification service that detects candidate substitution by comparing facial structure and vocal signatures across applications, interviews, assessments, and onboarding.
